snippets.snippet_text: "For one, Payhip offers a wider range of built-in features including a course builder, product variants, marketing tools, an affiliate program, and more advanced customization. Gumroad, on the other hand, is a bit easier to use since it's mainly a solution that allows creators to accept payments online."
"That being said, Payhip does have one key advantage over Gumroad: slightly lower fees. With Payhip, you'll have to pay a 5% transaction fee, whereas Gumroad charges a 10% fee on all sales."

intake_notes: Blog post from Sellfy (a competing platform), January 20, 2025. SNP-002 explicitly states Payhip 5% vs Gumroad 10% transaction fee. SNP-001 describes Payhip's broader feature set vs Gumroad's simpler payments-only model.
current_vs_historical_ambiguity: January 2025 data; fee structures may have evolved.
Source is from a competing platform (Sellfy); competitive framing present but fee data is consistent with other sources.
